### A Prayer of Praise for Who God Is
Author: Heidi Vegh
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-praise-god.html
Passage: Psalm 150:6
Points:
- Scripture should not be read merely for self-help, but to understand who God is.
- True peace comes from focusing on the Lord's character rather than just seeking personal solutions.
- While the Bible makes space for sorrow and lament, it continually summons believers to worship.
- God's infinite attributes provide the exact remedy for human suffering and weakness.

### A Call to Praise the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/call-praise-lord
Passage: Psalm 150:1–6
Points:
- The Psalter finishes by urging every living creature to offer unceasing praise to the Creator.
- Obeying God's commandments is not the ultimate end; it is designed to produce heartfelt worship.
- God's people may appropriately use all kinds of musical instruments to magnify His greatness and works.
- Through Jesus Christ, this call to praise unites both Jews and Gentiles across the world.
- A growing eagerness to praise the Lord is a vital indicator of genuine obedience.
